oneTime.conservativeAccounting: Charges both ordinary observation requests in full, plus all three real native shadow requests. Compilation, independent fixture validation, signing and approval/deployment wall time are included.
oneTime.unpricedAndUnmeasuredSetup: Existing control-plane bootstrap and module imports precede the setup clock. Their CPU/hosting/deployment and human approval costs are unpriced; they are not assumed free. Break-even is measured inference-equivalent and workflow-wall-time only, not total business ROI.

latency.observationWindowNote: Observer begins before capability offer retrieval. Time outside its window includes thread archive and telemetry, and is not an isolated SDK overhead measurement. Complete request latency includes every part.

providerAccounting.warningDiagnostics: A separate follow-up request identified an ignored features.apply_patch setting and the deliberately removed skill catalog. The exact distribution of the 78 original warnings was not retained. No reroutes or failed turns occurred. The ignored flag was removed from the final harness; read-only sandboxing was enforced throughout.
providerAccounting.transportCounterLimitation: This CLI build exported no OTEL request counters. Model-call counts describe provider-reported completed inference responses. Hidden failed/retried transport attempts cannot be audited from these results.

experimentTotals.interpretation: Includes setup, warmups, measured baselines and the real rollback fallback check. Development pilots are recorded separately in the written report. Harness CPU excludes the separate Codex process; wall time includes it.
